title: Aqua & Pet Feed Line
hero_lead: Extrusion-based lines for floating and sinking fish feed, shrimp feed and pet food — 2 to 20 tonnes per hour.
body_intro:
Aqua and pet lines replace the pellet mill heart with SMHS wet extrusion, add SHGW belt drying and coating, and keep the same cleaning, grinding and packing sections around them.

Fine grinding and starch cook give the water stability aqua species demand; die changes switch the same line between floating, sinking and pet products.
secondary_text: Floating and sinking product by recipe and die; belt drying and oil coating included; species-specific fine-grinding specified up front.
flow_intro: Every SEMZON line follows the same accountable flow — see it animated on the homepage plant-flow .
meta_description: Extrusion-based lines for floating and sinking fish feed, shrimp feed and pet food — 2 to 20 tonnes per hour.

title: Biomass Wood Pellet Line
hero_lead: Fuel pellet plants from 2 to 20 tonnes per hour — sawdust, rice husk and chipped wood into dense 6–10 mm biomass pellets.
body_intro:
Biomass lines adapt the feed-plant backbone to woody raw material: heavier grinding, drying to pelleting moisture, high-compression dies and counterflow cooling for a hard, low-fines fuel pellet.

Raw-material flexibility is engineered in, because the cheapest fibre next year may not be this year's.
secondary_text: Handles sawdust, husk and chips; 6–10 mm fuel pellet output; drying stage matched to raw-material moisture.
flow_intro: Every SEMZON line follows the same accountable flow — see it animated on the homepage plant-flow .
meta_description: Fuel pellet plants from 2 to 20 tonnes per hour — sawdust, rice husk and chipped wood into dense 6–10 mm biomass pellets.

title: BOP Fertilizer Plant
hero_lead: Bone-based BOP fertilizer plants at 50–200 tonnes per day — grinding, granulation, drying and screening as one delivered line.
body_intro:
BOP plants apply the same process discipline as our SSP scope to bone-derived fertilizer: raw grinding, granulation, drying, screening and bagging, engineered together so each stage feeds the next at rate.

Auriga, Karachi — a SEMZON BOP delivery — anchors the reference list.
secondary_text: Granulation-centred flowsheet; drying and screening matched to granule spec; bagging to 50 kg.
flow_intro: Every SEMZON line follows the same accountable flow — see it animated on the homepage plant-flow .
meta_description: Bone-based BOP fertilizer plants at 50–200 tonnes per day — grinding, granulation, drying and screening as one delivered line.

title: Cattle Feed Line
hero_lead: Right-sized cattle and dairy feed plants — compact manual and semi-automatic lines that grow with your herd book.
body_intro:
Cattle feed lines pare the six-stage flow down to what dairy and fattening rations actually need: robust grinding, accurate mixing with molasses addition, and pelleting where the market pays for it.

Start manual, automate batching later — the layout is planned for the upgrade on day one.
secondary_text: Molasses and liquid addition designed in; mash-only or mash+pellet configurations; staged automation path.

title: NPK & Compound Fertilizer
hero_lead: Compound and blended NPK production — dosing, granulation, drying and screening engineered around your formulations.
body_intro:
NPK scope combines accurate multi-ingredient dosing with granulation, drying, cooling and screening so each granule carries the declared analysis.

Formulation flexibility is the design driver: the same plant runs seasonal grades without rebuilding the front end.
secondary_text: Multi-ingredient batching; granulation and polish screening; seasonal grade changeovers planned in.

body_intro:
SEMZON compost plants take mixed organic waste through sorting, size reduction, controlled maturation and final screening, turning a disposal cost into a product line.

Our waste-management installation at Quetta is the working reference for this scope.

title: Poultry & Livestock Feed Line
hero_lead: Complete poultry and livestock feed plants from 10 to 80 tonnes per hour — grinding to bagging under one signature.
body_intro:
SEMZON poultry and livestock lines carry raw maize and meal through cleaning, grinding, batching, pelleting, cooling, crumbling and packing in one engineered flow — the same six stages you can walk through on our homepage, sized to your market.

Reference installations include the 20 t/h fully automated Albadar Feed plant in Kabul and pellet systems for Roshan Feeds, Gujranwala — designed, fabricated and commissioned by the same Lahore team that supports them today.
secondary_text: Mash, pellet and crumb products from one line; capacities stepped from 10 to 80 t/h; full PLC automation available from day one or as a later retrofit.

title: SSP Fertilizer Plant
hero_lead: Single Super Phosphate plants from 50 to 200 tonnes per day — rock phosphate and acid in, cured, granulated, bagged SSP out.
body_intro:
SEMZON SSP plants cover the full process chain: rock grinding, acidulation, den curing, granulation, screening and bagging, with materials handling and structures fabricated in our own works.

The Auriga installation in Karachi is our standing reference for fertilizer-scale process fabrication delivered turnkey.
secondary_text: Complete process from acidulation to bagging; corrosion-conscious materials selection; structures and handling fabricated in-house.
